title: Add root traits (GRooT) — add_groot
text: Joins species-level root traits Global Root Traits (GRooT) database taxify() result looking accepted_name. GRooT aggregates root trait records per-species means. .vtr carries full GRooT trait set (38 root traits); default attaches nine best-populated key traits, cols = "" attaches every one. Run enrichment_cols("groot") list .

text: x data.frame returned taxify(). cols columns attach: NULL (default) nine key traits , "" every GRooT trait, character vector names. See enrichment_cols. verbose Logical. Default TRUE.

title: Add root traits (GRooT) — add_groot
text: data.frame additional columns (per-species means). default set: groot_root_diameter Mean root diameter. groot_specific_root_length Specific root length. groot_root_tissue_density Root tissue density. groot_root_n_concentration Root nitrogen concentration. groot_root_c_concentration Root carbon concentration. groot_root_mass_fraction Root mass fraction. groot_lateral_spread Lateral spread. groot_root_mycorrhizal_colonization Root mycorrhizal colonization intensity. groot_rooting_depth Maximum rooting depth. cols = "" additionally attaches root chemistry (P/K/Ca/Mg/Mn concentrations, C:N N:P ratios), architecture (branching density ratio, stele diameter fraction, cortex thickness, vessel diameter number), turnover (root lifespan, production, turnover rate, litter mass-loss rate), specific root area, respiration, dry-matter content, among others. Units follow GRooT data paper; see reference .

title: Inspect a name list for probable typos and other anomalies — inspect
text: Checks need matching (run character vector result): unknown genus genus register, union genera every backbone, backbone recognises . strong "probably real name" signal. near_duplicate near-twin frequent name list (small edit distance), probably misspelling . Computed list alone, catches typos names backbone contains. outlier_group name's kingdom group (register) tiny minority otherwise group-coherent list: lone animal fungus among plants, typically cross-kingdom homonym typo. Checks read taxify() result (present input one): typo Resolved fuzzy correction (match_type = "fuzzy"): input likely contains spelling error; suggestion name. rank_fallback infraspecific name backbone carry, resolved species (match_type = "rank_fallback"). ambiguous name backbone files one accepted taxon (n_ids > 1) accepted name; reason lists accepted IDs. geographic matched species real WCVP record declared region / coords (vascular plants ). out_of_range region declared, yet matched species' range falls outside list's main TDWG continents (skipped globally spread lists). case Resolved ignoring case (match_type = "exact_ci"). synonym input outdated synonym, name backbone keeps unplaced whose basionym places (match_type = "basionym"); suggestion current accepted name. Rows anomaly dropped. row gets tier describing needs, bad : unresolved (usable name: act ), review (name identity uncertain: verify ), note (correct, optional cleanup). unknown unresolved; identity-uncertain labels review; case synonym note. anomaly may intended, tier triage hint, verdict. list-context labels (near_duplicate, out_of_range, outlier_group) judge name rest batch, apply single name: inspect() one name warns reports per-name labels. register checks (unknown, register-derived outlier_group) need genus register installed, range checks need WCVP range data; check run named report header checked, empty report never mistaken clean one.

title: Match taxonomic names against local backbone databases — taxify
text: Matches vector taxonomic names locally stored Darwin Core backbone databases. Returns data.frame one row per input name containing matched name, accepted name, taxonomic hierarchy, match quality information.

title: Match taxonomic names against local backbone databases — taxify
code: taxify(   x,   backbone = NULL,   fuzzy = TRUE,   fuzzy_threshold = 0.2,   fuzzy_method = c("dl", "levenshtein", "jw"),   aggregates = c("preserve", "collapse"),   region = NULL,   coords = NULL,   range = c("present", "native", "introduced"),   kingdom = NULL,   mode = c("fallback", "wide", "agreement"),   verbose = TRUE )

title: Match taxonomic names against local backbone databases — taxify
text: x Character vector taxonomic names. backbone Character vector backbone names (e.g., "wfo", "col", "gbif") single taxify_backend object. Several tried order fallback chain. NULL (default) uses every installed backbone priority order, offering default set (COL, GBIF, ITIS) none installed; override priority options(taxify.backbone_priority = ...) first-run set options(taxify.default_backbones = ...). fuzzy Logical. Enable fuzzy matching names fail exact match. Default TRUE. fuzzy_threshold Numeric. Maximum allowed distance fuzzy matches. Two modes depending value: Fractional (0 < fuzzy_threshold < 1): normalized distance (edits / max name length). Default 0.2 1 edit per 5 characters. Integer (fuzzy_threshold >= 1): maximum raw edit count, e.g. fuzzy_threshold = 2L allows 2 insertions/deletions/substitutions regardless name length. supported fuzzy_method = "jw". fuzzy_method Character. One "dl" (Damerau-Levenshtein, default), "levenshtein", "jw" (Jaro-Winkler). aggregates Character. treat species aggregates (names agg. / s.l. qualifier). "preserve" (default) keeps aggregate concept: matches backbone's aggregate taxon ("<binomial> aggr.") one exists, otherwise falls back binomial. output's aggregate_fallback column records happened aggregate: TRUE fell back binomial, FALSE resolved dedicated aggregate taxon. Euro+Med WoRMS carry aggregate taxa, preserve falls back backbones. "collapse" strips marker matches binomial species, way non-aggregate name matched. Either way qualifier recorded qualifier column. region Region(s) constrain fuzzy matching , NULL (default) geographic constraint. Botanical (WCVP, vascular plants): TDWG Level 3 codes ("BGM", c("BGM", "GER")) region names level, matched case- accent-insensitively bundled WGSRPD crosswalk: Level 3 name ("Belgium"), Level 2 region ("Middle Europe"), Level 1 continent ("Europe", expands codes). Marine (marine_distribution asset installed): MEOW ecoregion ECO_CODE, ecoregion / province / realm name (province realm expands member ecoregions). See taxify_regions() lists. set, fuzzy candidates restricted species range records region(s); exact matches always kept. filter narrows genuinely ambiguous fuzzy candidates: candidate dropped input name another candidate -region range data, match group range coverage never affected name whose candidate --region still returned. coords Coordinates constrain fuzzy matching , mapped region codes point--polygon unioned region. Points tested WGSRPD botanical boundaries (yielding TDWG codes) , marine asset installed, MEOW ecoregion boundaries (yielding ECO_CODEs), coastal point can resolve . single c(lon, lat) pair, matrix/data.frame longitude/latitude columns (named lon/lat x/y, else first two columns lon, lat), point-geometry spatial object (sf/sfc object terra SpatVector, reprojected longitude/latitude automatically). NULL (default) none. boundary file downloaded cached; coordinate lookup needs download (prior cache). point-- polygon test uses terra sf installed, otherwise native fallback; force engine options(taxify.pip_engine = "terra" | "sf" | "native"). range Character. range statuses count -region region coords set. "present" (default) accepts record (native, introduced, extinct, unknown status), right choice name disambiguation. "native" accepts native records, "introduced" introduced (alien) records; fold ecological filter matching callers want . Ignored region set. kingdom Character. Restrict matches one kingdoms, disambiguate name shared across kingdoms (Prunella bird plant, Oenanthe ). NULL (default) applies constraint. Accepts kingdom name common alias, case-insensitively: "animals"/"Animalia"/"Metazoa", "plants"/"Plantae", "fungi", "bacteria", "archaea", "chromista", "protozoa", "viruses". matched taxon kept kingdom requested one (unknown, never rejected); default multi-backbone fallback, name backbone resolves wrong kingdom passed next backbone, -kingdom treatment wins. kingdom read backbone stores one (COL, ITIS, NCBI, OTT, WoRMS); backbone (WFO, GBIF), falls back genus register's kingdom, split genus homonymous across kingdoms; name kingdom-appropriate backbone . mode Character. combine results backbone names one backbone. "fallback" (default) fallback chain described : one answer per name, first backbone matched. "wide" "agreement" instead consult every backbone every name report compare, backbone disagreement (see Backbone-specific accepted names section) visible one call rather querying backbone hand. return strict superset "fallback" result (standard columns, accepted_name still fallback pick, frame still pipes add_*() enrichments) plus: "wide": one accepted_<backbone> column per backbone logical all_agree. "agreement": n_backbones_matched, n_distinct_accepted, all_agree. all_agree TRUE/FALSE least two backbones matched name NA fewer two (nothing compare). Ignored (message) one backbone given, since nothing compare. verbose Logical. Print progress messages. Default TRUE.

title: Match taxonomic names against local backbone databases — taxify
text: data.frame one row per input name following columns: input_name original name provided. matched_name Full name backbone matched. unresolved hybrid formula (match_type = "hybrid_formula") holds input-parent cross (e.g. "Salix alba x Salix fragilis") parents resolve, else NA. accepted_name Resolved accepted name (equals matched_name synonym). hybrid formula holds accepted-parent cross (parents resolved), else NA. taxon_id Backend-specific ID matched name. accepted_id ID accepted name. rank Taxonomic rank (species, subspecies, genus, etc.). family Family name. genus Genus name. epithet Specific epithet. authorship Authorship matched name. accepted_authorship Authorship accepted name. synonym author resolved accepted name, synonym's author, accepted_name accepted_authorship together form accepted name's full citation. is_synonym Logical. matched name resolve different accepted taxon? TRUE synonym record, unplaced record resolved basionym (match_type = "basionym"). taxonomic_status matched record's status backbone writes ("ACCEPTED", "SYNONYM", WFO's "UNCHECKED", COL's "PROVISIONALLY ACCEPTED", ...), name backbone holds without placed can told accepted one. NA nothing matched. is_hybrid Logical. hybrid marker detected input? hybrid_type "nothogenus" ("x Cupressocyparis leylandii"), "nothospecies" ("Quercus x hispanica"), "formula" ("Salix alba x Salix fragilis"), NA non-hybrid. Nothogenus nothospecies resolve single backbone taxon usual columns. formula resolves way backbone stores cross; otherwise match_type "hybrid_formula", ID, rank classification columns NA, matched_name / accepted_name name cross parents parents resolve. parent binomials, accepted names, added demand add_hybrid_info(). qualifier Canonical taxonomic qualifier found input name ("cf.", "aff.", "agg.", "s.l.", "s.str.", "sp.", ...), NA. Spelling variants folded one token ("aggr.", "agg" "sensu lato" map "agg."/"s.l."). qualifier_position "genus" qualifier leads name qualifies whole name (e.g. "Cf. Pinus sylvestris"), "species" qualifies species (inline cf. trailing agg.), NA qualifier. aggregate_fallback Logical. aggregate query aggregates = "preserve": FALSE resolved backbone's dedicated aggregate taxon, TRUE taxon existed fell back nominal binomial. NA non-aggregate queries aggregates = "collapse", collapse explicit. match_type One "exact", "exact_ci", "fuzzy", "abbrev" (abbreviated genus "Q. robur" resolved via genus initial plus epithet), "hybrid_formula" (two-parent cross backbone store; ID, rank classification columns NA, matched_name / accepted_name name cross parents resolve, add_hybrid_info() materializes parents hybrid_parent_* columns), "rank_fallback" (infraspecific name backbone carries, resolved species: ID, rank name columns describe species), "basionym" (record backbone keeps unplaced, resolved taxon places record's basionym: matched_name, taxon_id taxonomic_status describe unplaced record, accepted_* columns taxon; needs backbone built basionym links), "none". fuzzy_dist Normalized string distance (0–1), NA exact. n_ids Integer. many distinct accepted taxa backbone files matched name , across every record (accepted, doubtful, unplaced, synonym). 1 name one accepted ID; homonym name backbone holds twice, e.g. GBIF's Karwinskia mollis, kept accepted Schltdl. name doubtful Standl. one. NA nothing matched. accepted_ids Character. accepted IDs, |-joined, one accepted_id first (accepted_id name one). columns every result; printing leaves row one ID. List names, status GBIF occurrence counts taxify_ids(). backbone backbone used (e.g., "wfo", "col", "gbif"). backbone_version Backend name, version, download date (e.g., "wfo:2024-12 (2026-04-01)"). Useful reproducibility. kingdom_group Coarse kingdom-level group matched genus, bundled genus register (used cross-kingdom disambiguation); NA genus register. taxon_group Broad taxonomic group matched genus, genus register; NA unavailable. life_form Life-form classification matched genus, genus register's family-based lookup; NA unavailable.

title: taxify 0.2.13
text: leading genus-level Cf. prefix (e.g. "Cf. Pinus sylvestris") now recorded cf. qualifier clean_names(), clean_one(), add_qualifier_info(). Previously prefix stripped matching qualifier lost, inline cf. (e.g. "Pinus cf. sylvestris") reported. add_qualifier_info() now also matches prefix case-insensitively reports qualifier_position = 1.

title: taxify 0.2.12
text: CRAN release: 2026-06-30

title: taxify 0.2.12
text: taxify_data_dir() can now redirected taxify.data_dir option TAXIFY_DATA_DIR environment variable, cache location configurable (shared caches, scratch directories, bundled example data). taxify_example_data() returns path small bundled example database (handful species per backbone plus matching enrichment tables). Setting options(taxify.data_dir = taxify_example_data()) lets matching enrichment run fully offline.

title: taxify 0.2.12
text: Examples now run bundled example database instead wrapped \dontrun{}. add_pignatti() (fetched live via TR8) list_enrichments() (reads online manifest) remain \donttest{}.

title: taxify 0.2.11
text: add_floraweb() joins German-flora plant traits FloraWeb (live BfN portal carrying BiolFlor data Klotz, Kuehn & Durka 2002, plus Rothmaler morphology Ellenberg indicator values). bundles full per-species trait profile – morphology, reproductive biology, nine Ellenberg indicator values, ploidy chromosome number, chorological distribution (59 _de columns) – pre-built dataset, works offline.

title: taxify 0.2.11
text: add_ecoflora() now joins bundled, pre-built Ecoflora dataset (18 _uk columns: canopy height, leaf traits, life form, flowering phenology, pollination, seed weight, British-calibrated Ellenberg values) instead fetching live TR8. works offline returns full trait set rather previous five columns. add_pignatti() remains -demand TR8 source: values copyrighted publication redistributed.

title: taxify 0.2.10
text: add_ecoflora(), add_biolflor(), add_pignatti() join plant traits taxify ship pre-built dataset, accessing demand suggested TR8 package machine; taxify redistributes nothing. reasons differ source: add_ecoflora() adds British flowering months, pollen vector, life form, leaf longevity (CC -NC-SA, allow redistribution, ecoflora.org.uk bulk download, fetched live per species); add_biolflor() adds Grime CSR strategy type, breeding system, pollen vector, life form, life span, apomixis (usable acknowledgement + citation per BioFresh metadata statement, bulk copy obtainable UFZ site offline, fetched live); add_pignatti() adds Italian Ellenberg-type indicator values, life form, chorotype (copyrighted; read copy bundled TR8, TR8 redistributes, taxify; works offline). Columns region-suffixed (_uk/_de/_it) never collide add_baseflor(). TR8 Suggests dependency. live source (Ecoflora, BiolFlor) unreachable call errors rather attaching silent NA.

title: taxify 0.2.9
text: add_baseflor() joins plant traits Baseflor (Programme Catminat, Julve 1998 ff.; ODbL 1.0 / CC -SA 2.0) taxify() result. covers ~7,000 vascular plant taxa France neighbouring regions adds flowering phenology (flower_begin_month, flower_end_month), pollination vector, dispersal mode, breeding system, flower colour, fruit type, woody growth form, continentality salinity indicator-value axes absent EIVE. enrichment registered manifest (list_enrichments()) pre-built .vtr; light/temperature/moisture/reaction/nutrient axes left add_eive() Raunkiaer life form add_leda().

title: taxify 0.2.8
text: Added end--end regression test (tests/e2e/test-e2e-enrichment.R) enrichment join fixed 0.2.5 (#1). checks add_conservation_status(), add_common_names(), add_woodiness() attach value row’s accepted taxon, stay invariant batch composition order, land documented values correct species.

title: taxify 0.2.7
text: Abbreviated-genus names "Q. robur" now resolve. matching pass restricts backbone rows whose genus starts given initial whose specific epithet matches, resolving unique. two genera sharing initial also share epithet abbreviation ambiguous: row left unmatched is_ambiguous = TRUE conflicting accepted IDs ambiguous_targets, rather guessing genus. genus spelled full elsewhere input takes precedence (convention abbreviating first mention). Resolved rows carry match_type = "abbrev".

title: taxify 0.2.6
text: New accepted_authorship output column: authorship resolved accepted name. synonym match, authorship holds synonym’s author accepted_authorship holds accepted name’s author, accepted_name accepted_authorship together form accepted taxon’s full citation. Backbones carry authorship populate ; sources without authorship (NCBI, OTT) return NA.

title: taxify 0.2.6
text: taxify() longer errors “replacement length zero” backbones whose .meta sidecar records build date build_date (current taxifydb build format) rather download_date. Backbone metadata now reads layouts version formatting tolerates missing date. previously broke matching WoRMS Open Tree Life backbones.

title: taxify 0.2.6
text: Declared companion build package taxifydb Additional_repositories (https://gcol33.r-universe.dev), location discoverable required Suggests dependency outside mainstream repositories.

title: taxify 0.2.5
text: taxify() longer errors “incorrect number dimensions” genus register present backend-coverage file (state clean install coverage download, package checks). early return() evaluated inside tryCatch() expression returned NULL pre-filter, $<- turned list; --scope pre-filter now resolves missing coverage -op preserves result data frame. Replaced non-ASCII characters roxygen documentation ASCII equivalents PDF reference manual builds LaTeX.

title: taxify 0.2.4
text: Ambiguous homonym synonyms now resolve epithet-preserving accepted name (homotypic basionym) instead arbitrary lowest-id candidate. taxify("Pinus abies") resolves Picea abies (Picea polita), spurious is_ambiguous flag cleared one candidate keeps specific epithet (#2). Genuinely ambiguous names (candidate, several, preserving epithet) still flagged. Silenced tidyselect deprecation warnings emitted fuzzy matching.

title: taxify 0.2.4
text: score_candidates() exported (kept internal reference index) companion taxifydb build pipeline can collapse backbone key single accepted name taxify() resolves . corrects enrichment joins previously landed trait/status values within-genus neighbours (#1); fix reaches users rebuilt enrichment data.
